title: Three Years and One Short Key
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：manager　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 manager 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the clerk ① became the manager that no worker in the warehouse would have recorded, and he said the becoming was the whole of the year. The ② manager, meaning the head itself and not the key, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a manager, he said, is the only thing in a warehouse that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ manager in that warehouse had the same short key beside it, and the ④ manager at the far office, meaning the post they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A manager, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the manager was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the head. The ⑥ manager, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; manager, he said, is either something you become or the only word that means both a head and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ manager had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short key. The ⑧ manager of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in September, was one warehouse and three years of recording; manager, he said, is either the post at the far office or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ manager I remember is the head recorded in the report, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the warehouse. A ⑩ manager, my mother said in 1987, is the only head that improves by being recorded; every manager, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like a head. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。

B. n. 经理；管理人（指那位管理人本身，与钥匙相对）

items.q: became the manager that no worker in the warehouse would have recorded

the manager at the far office

answers.why: become the manager 意为“当上这位经理”，1978 年那位伙计把货栈里没有一位工人肯记载的一位经理做了一遍。
manager 意为“经理；管理人”，指那位管理人本身而不是钥匙，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
manager 意为“经理；管理人”，指货栈里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一把小小的钥匙。
manager 意为“经理；管理人”，指最远那间账房留给孩子们接的那一任那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
manager 意为“职责、担子”，指一件事里人人都管却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份职责就是那件事的全部。
manager 意为“担子”，指人人都管却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位管理人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
manager 意为“经理；管理人”，指工作报告里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1983 年这一位成了工作报告里的一行。
manager 意为“管事之事”，伙计九月写道，整件事的经理之事是一处货栈和三个年头的记载。
manager 意为“经理；管理人”，我记得的是工作报告里记载过的那一位，1985 年当完了，至今仍被说成货栈里最安静的一位。
manager 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，经理是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的管理人。
